source_name: EBRD Nominee Director Board Practice + External Board Nominee Register
why_relevant: Explains and administers the mechanism by which EBRD places nominee directors on the boards of banks it holds equity in, including Ukrainian financial institutions. Calls for register applicants are an early signal that EBRD is preparing board placements.

source_name: EBRD jobs portal (jobs.ebrd.com) incl. Kyiv postings
why_relevant: Vacancy flow for EBRD's Kyiv resident office (bankers, FI analysts, donor-finance roles) is a leading indicator of where the DFI is expanding its Ukrainian financial-sector team — a hiring signal that precedes deal and leadership news.

source_name: Impactpool / UNjobs / untalent EBRD vacancy mirrors
why_relevant: Third-party mirrors of IFI vacancies retain postings after they are pulled from the official ATS, giving a historical hiring record for EBRD Kyiv that the primary portal does not preserve.

source_name: IFC Pressroom — country-manager appointment releases
why_relevant: IFC announces its Country Manager for Ukraine and Moldova via a dedicated press release format ('IFC Appoints New Country Manager for ...'), which is the only reliable venue for these appointments.

source_name: World Bank Group — Kyiv Regional Country Director announcements
why_relevant: WBG Regional Country Director based in Kyiv is appointed and announced by Washington in English (e.g. the 2024 Bob Saum appointment). Sits above/alongside IFC's country manager and shapes financial-sector programme leadership.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — banking/payments personnel news
why_relevant: High-volume Ukrainian financial portal that reliably picks up scheme and foreign-parent bank appointment news in Ukrainian; useful as a second-source confirmation and for items the schemes do not translate.

source_name: FinClub (finclub.net) — Ukrainian banking-sector personnel desk
why_relevant: Specialist Ukrainian banking outlet that covers board hirings and dismissals at foreign-owned banks (e.g. OTP Bank's dismissal of its board chair) in detail that general media skip.

source_name: Interfax-Ukraine (en.interfax.com.ua / interfax.com)
why_relevant: Wire service that carries both Ukrainian bank board changes and DFI country-head appointments in English, giving a timestamped, citable record that bridges the parent-group and local layers.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA Ukraine) member directory — scheme representative offices
why_relevant: Lists the legal representative offices of foreign schemes in Ukraine (e.g. 'Представництво Мастеркард Юроп СА') with named contact leadership, and EBA committee rosters reveal which scheme executives hold Ukraine-facing roles.

source_name: YouControl / Opendatabot — company officer records for scheme and parent entities in Ukraine
why_relevant: Ukrainian registry aggregators expose the legally registered director/signatory of local entities such as TOV 'Viza Ukraina' (EDRPOU 37615537). Registry changes are a hard, dated confirmation of a leadership change independent of PR timing.

source_name: Western Union careers portal
why_relevant: Western Union does not publish Ukraine leadership appointments in press releases; its ATS is the only observable channel showing Ukraine/CEE-region role openings and therefore its organisational footprint and hiring intent.

source_name: NV Business (english.nv.ua / nv.ua) — executive interviews with scheme leaders
why_relevant: Runs the first Ukrainian interviews with newly appointed scheme executives (Visa's new CEMEA regional president; Mastercard's Ukraine country manager), which reveal mandate, priorities and reporting structure that the appointment release omits.

source_name: Prozorro — Ukrainian public e-procurement portal (tender search)
why_relevant: Legally mandated publication channel for all state/SOE procurement, including NBU, Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, Sense Bank, Ukrgasbank, Treasury and Diia. Tender titles, technical specs, contact persons and responsible units expose core-banking migrations, payment-hub projects, HR/consulting engagements and reorganisation programmes months before public announcement.

source_name: Prozorro / OpenProcurement public API (OCDS-compliant)
why_relevant: Machine-readable bulk access to the same central procurement database, in Open Contracting Data Standard. Enables systematic longitudinal monitoring of banking/payments IT and HR-consulting tenders by CPV and buyer, rather than ad-hoc web scraping.

source_name: DOZORRO — civic monitoring platform for Ukrainian public procurement
why_relevant: Aggregates risk indicators, monitoring reports and civic analysis of Prozorro tenders. Useful as a pointer to contested or unusual banking-sector procurements, and to the analytical toolset (BI modules, risk.dozorro.org) that surfaces which state banks are buying what.

source_name: BI Prozorro — public procurement analytics module
why_relevant: Qlik-based analytics over the full Prozorro dataset since 2015 (built by Transparency International Ukraine with EBRD support), enriched with state registers and OpenDataBot data. Fast way to profile a state bank's or the NBU's supplier landscape and spending trend by category, which indirectly reveals IT/organisational programmes.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — procurement knowledge base and practitioner articles
why_relevant: Official Prozorro editorial channel explaining procedures, tools and case studies, including NBU procurement practice and EBRD procurement opportunities in Ukraine. Good for learning the vocabulary and locating adjacent portals and donor channels.

source_name: Spending.gov.ua / E-data — unified portal on use of public funds (Treasury transactions)
why_relevant: Publishes Treasury-level payment transactions and contracts of budget holders (reportedly ~196m transactions). Payments to IT vendors, HR/executive-search firms and consultancies confirm which contracts actually executed, and at what pace — a check on announced-but-never-run programmes.

source_name: SE Diia (ДП «ДІЯ») procurement page
why_relevant: The state enterprise operating the Diia ecosystem publishes its own procurement notices. Diia integrates payment and identity rails used by banks (BankID, e-signature, digital documents); its tenders reveal upcoming platform capabilities and the vendor/consultant bench, plus responsible units.

source_name: Verkhovna Rada Committee on Finance, Tax and Customs Policy — competitive selection notices
why_relevant: The parliamentary finance committee itself announces competitive selection for vacant supervisory board seats at state banks (e.g. Ukreximbank), an under-watched second channel distinct from Cabinet/MoF.

source_name: Opendatabot — tenders and registry-change monitoring by company (EDRPOU)
why_relevant: Aggregates Prozorro tenders with the Unified State Register, so a single query returns both a state bank's procurement activity and changes of director/beneficiary/legal form — a direct join of the procurement signal to the leadership/organisation signal.

source_name: tender.uub.com.ua — per-company Prozorro tender mirror (NBU, Oschadbank, branches)
why_relevant: Convenient per-buyer aggregation pages for NBU (EDRPOU 00032106), Oschadbank (00032129) and its regional branches, plus explainer content on consulting tenders in Prozorro. Useful as a quick index and for discovering EDRPOU codes; the authoritative record remains Prozorro.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU)
why_relevant: Publishes EU-funded and EU-institution notices, including technical assistance to Ukraine. EU delegation / EIB / EU4Digital-type TA contracts for banking supervision, payments modernisation and public financial management name beneficiary institutions and the reform workstreams behind organisational change.

source_name: EBRD Client E-Procurement Portal (ECEPP)
why_relevant: Default channel for all EBRD client-led procurement since 2020, including Ukraine procurement-support and financial-sector TA. EBRD is a major funder of Ukrainian banking-sector modernisation and of the Prozorro/BI tooling itself; its notices name implementing units and consultants.

source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices (incl. UNDP Ukraine)
why_relevant: UNDP Ukraine procures e-services, digital government and financial-inclusion consultancy (e.g. UNDP-UKR-01058 E-Services LTA). Individual-consultant notices are especially revealing of upcoming institutional reform workstreams and of who staffs them.

source_name: UNGM — United Nations Global Marketplace
why_relevant: Cross-agency aggregation of UN-system tender notices (40+ organisations), covering Ukraine reconstruction and digital/financial-services consultancy that does not appear on Prozorro.

source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations / Procurement portal — Ukraine
why_relevant: World Bank-financed Ukraine operations include public financial management, governance and financial-sector components; general procurement notices and consultant selections identify the implementing agency, its PIU staffing and the reform agenda.
